doctrine: Never raise a score without current-head runtime evidence (receipt paths + digests).
Unavailable hardware is BLOCKED, not failed, and must not be fabricated.
Do not score a facet on capability that exists but does not work.
Print bad numbers in the body of the scorecard, not only footnotes.

external_blockers.requirement: Host with openable physical webcam/camera so live streaming and live calibration leave BLOCKED under attestation without fabricating frames.
Three unseen real-world targets with authorized captures, scored under frozen thresholds without manual implementation changes.
Rights-cleared multiview stills and/or video of a real animal, explicit rights_state OWNED or LICENSED, and ethical-use attestation.
Authorized multiview photographs plus measurements of the user-owned consumer object; governed self-captured fixture is never described as the user's object.
CUDA-capable COLMAP build (installed 4.0.4 is CPU-only so patch_match_stereo cannot run).
Human art-director sign-off on flagship film lighting and framing.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Recorded-stream calibration uses image_centre_fallback with authority INFERRED; no metrology lab board on a live sensor. Checkerboard path is unit-exercised via vision.calibrate_sensor MCP tool.
failed_attempts: Live webcam calibrate_sensor cannot run: webcam BLOCKED on this host.
limitations: Stream calibration method is image_centre_fallback, not a measured lens model.
No physical scale anchor without a ruler/credit-card reference (remote measurements mark scale unknown).

remaining_blocker.requirement: Host with openable webcam (or authorized capture device) so calibrate_sensor can run on live frames rather than image-centre fallback.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Physical recorded video_file stream: 48 frames emitted, 0 drops, timestamps monotonic, incremental consumption. Webcam probe attested BLOCKED without fabricating frames.
failed_attempts: Earlier stream accounting bug reported 44 dropped frames that had actually been delivered (fixed; receipt now 0 drops).
limitations: Live camera path is BLOCKED on this host (no camera); recorded stream only.
fabricated_live_frame is false — absence is attested, not invented.
facets.notes: Recorded streaming is scoreable; live webcam is blocked, not failed.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Physical webcam present and openable so vision.open_stream(allow_webcam=true) can leave BLOCKED and emit live frames under PHYSICAL authority.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Stream receipt records fixation_count=48 on the recorded sequence; retina fixtures for camera_motion and object_motion were Blender-generated under RUNTIME_OBSERVED.
limitations: No sealed metric that foveal crops improve recognition vs full-frame compute.
Foveation machinery exists; quality of the foveal policy is not separately proven.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed task showing information gain or accuracy lift from foveated compute vs uniform full-frame on held-out sequences.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: vision.fixate and vision.saccade execute over stdio MCP (19/19 ocular tools). Stream processes 48 fixations with inhibition-of-return plumbing in gaze.py.
limitations: No sealed saliency-vs-task ranking benchmark with human or oracle labels.
Attention budget is implemented; optimality is not measured.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Held-out sequences with task goals where fixation order is scored against an information-gain oracle or human gaze.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Proposal-fusion detection scored against sealed GT in evaluator role only, across 11 hard conditions at IoU 0.5. Detector never opens sealed_gt/.
failed_attempts: Pre-fix detector returned full-frame table/shadow blobs: recall 0.011, matched IoU 0.020, large-area blobs 1.00/frame.
Containment-in-support-plane was treated as identity; fusion ranked by area.
limitations: detection_recall=0.38375946969696967 — still well under useful operating levels.
detection_precision=0.19577235422405878 (~0.196) — majority of detections are false.
mean_matched_iou=0.4571001368154998; mean_large_area_dets_per_frame=0.0 (fixed vs 1.00).
Classical segmentation only; no licensed promptable/learned segmenter weights on this host.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Raise sealed detection precision well above 0.196 and recall above ~0.38 on the 11-condition hard suite without GT leakage into the detector.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Perception-driven tracking on Blender Eevee hard suite (11 conditions). No GT-seeded boxes. IDF1 examples: visually_similar 0.910, crossing_paths 0.736, lighting_change 0.985, scale_change 0.481.
failed_attempts: Suite FAILS three gates: permanence id_switches=22>12; crossing_paths id_switches=14>12; unknown entrant absorbed into existing identity.
Historical GT-seeded baseline looked better; that path is forbidden.
limitations: MOTA remains low on several conditions (e.g. full_occlusion ~0.198, scale_change ~0.200).
Fragmentation after detector fix raises ID switches — recorded, not retuned away.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Perception-driven hard suite must pass ID-switch gates (permanence and crossing_paths <=12), refuse unknown absorption, and keep distractor false-reid false without relaxing thresholds.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Distractor replacement condition id_switches=1; permanence distractor_refused passes (appearance-only re-id correctly refused). leave_return same-id recovery fails.
failed_attempts: leave_return_same_id is false with multiple FP re-id events on return frames.
Permanence identity_preserved_on_return is false (0 same-id return frames of 7).
limitations: Appearance histogram re-id without strong kinematics fails under occlusion+return.
No learned re-id embedding; classical appearance only.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Evidence-backed re-id that preserves identity across leave/return and full occlusion on the sealed permanence and leave_return conditions.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Sealed permanence evaluation on perception-derived tracks: n_pass=1 of n_questions=4, status FAIL. entity_count=14 over 32 frames. identity_provenance=perception (allow_ground_truth=false).
failed_attempts: Only distractor_refused passes; identity_preserved_on_return, uncertainty_fell_after_reid, uncertainty_grew_while_occluded all fail.
Permanence tracking id_switches=22 against threshold 12.
limitations: Object permanence is implemented as a belief/track state machine but does not hold under sealed scoring.
Do not score this facet on capability that exists but does not work.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed permanence questions must pass at least identity preservation on return and uncertainty growth while occluded without GT-seeded tracks.

facets.reproduction_command: .venv/bin/python scripts/run-ocular-tracking.py --output artifacts/ocular/tracking # sealed permanence questions also recorded in artifacts/ocular/permanence.json

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Classical multiscale / appearance features drive proposal fusion (mean 5.74 dets/frame). No licensed dense foundation-model weights selected for PHYSICAL use.
failed_attempts: Model intake leaves learned dense backends DOWNLOAD_REQUIRED / non-selectable without checkpoints.
limitations: Dense features are classical and bounded; not a universal embedding cortex.
Feature quality is only indirectly evidenced via detection/tracking metrics.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Rights-cleared dense visual backbone with checkpoint on disk, intake receipt, and sealed uplift vs classical features.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Remote loop builds perception-derived entities (entity_count=6) from 25 train images; portfolio emits mesh/point_cloud candidates. Depth is model/sensor-derived at best.
limitations: No dedicated ocular depth accuracy receipt (AbsRel/δ) against sealed depth GT.
COLMAP dense MVS remains blocked without CUDA (inherited V2 blocker).
facets.notes: Scored low/partial on remote+portfolio geometry only; no depth-quality artifact.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed depth evaluation (e.g. AbsRel, δ1) on ocular streams with declared sensor or multiview authority; CUDA COLMAP or other dense path if claimed.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: CAMERA_MOVED event calibration: precision=1.0, recall=1.0, fpr=0.0 on sealed fixtures. Stream camera path is video_file with inferred intrinsics.
limitations: Live camera blocked; no physical extrinsics recovery from a moving handheld sensor.
Camera model in stream is image_centre_fallback.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Live calibrated camera with measured intrinsics/extrinsics receipts under PHYSICAL authority.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Portfolio PASS on 5 targets (datacenter, organic_fur, remote, soft_object, tabletop) with mesh/point_cloud/procedural executed; gaussian_radiance blocked without weights. Remote loop emits next-view plan and relative measurements.
failed_attempts: Radiance/Gaussian blocked: no trained weights; network download forbidden.
limitations: Geometry is multi-representation scaffolding plus procedural/mesh candidates, not a measured reconstruction RMSE leaderboard for ocular streams.
User-owned remote photographs are still absent (governed fixture only).

remaining_blocker.requirement: Authorized multiview photographs of a user-owned object with scale reference; do not describe the governed fixture as the user's object.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Hard-suite prediction calibration: total_surprises_fired=3551, overall_surprise_tp=28, overall_surprise_precision=0.007885102787947058 (~0.8%), visibility_accuracy=0.9448621553884712, total_predictions=14142. Verdict signal_or_noise=noise.
failed_attempts: Stream headline previously reported 441 predictions / 128 surprises with no correctness evidence; this artifact supplies that evidence.
limitations: Surprise precision ~0.8% means the predictive loop does not work as a truth-telling system.
Visibility prediction is relatively strong (0.945) but does not redeem surprise noise.
Do not score this facet as if the predictive loop works.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Overall surprise precision far above 0.0079 on sealed hard conditions with thresholds not fit to sealed labels.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: World receipt: n_entities=2, n_belief_updates=18; dynamic_room change classes detected (new/removed/moved/lighting/same). MCP world tools execute. Permanence sealed 1/4.
failed_attempts: Permanence FAIL dominates long-horizon trust.
World sequence_meta notes benchmarks/ocular_tabletop absent; driven from grouped fixtures.
limitations: Cross-session continuity is partially demonstrated on synthetic dynamic_room, not on live tabletop camera.
Entity beliefs are perception-derived; quality tracks detection/tracking weakness.

remaining_blocker.requirement: World memory that survives occlusion and leave/return under sealed permanence questions.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Stream next_best_view emits request_count=10 with uncertainty_before and information_gain fields; remote loop emits 6 next-view requests with expected_reduction values. vision.plan_capture / ask_next_view / measure_information_gain execute via MCP.
limitations: Requests are ranked and emitted; closed-loop proof that following them reduces sealed uncertainty is limited.
Live guided capture requires a human+camera not present on this host.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Measure views-to-target-uncertainty on sealed targets when acting on ask_next_view vs random/fixed baselines.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Stream information_gain.expected_reduction=0.221665 with disagreement_reduction=0.2025; remote next_view_plan.request_count=6. Machinery for efficiency measurement exists.
limitations: No sealed views-to-threshold curve comparing active vs passive capture policies.
Efficiency is therefore partial: ranked requests, not proven sample-efficiency gains.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Benchmark 10 (Bible §26): measure how many requested views are required to reach target uncertainty on sealed objects.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Sensitivity summary: n_authoritative=41, n_diagnostic=94, n_receipts=135, false_authoritative=false, critic_all_passed=true. Remote material hypotheses remain INFERRED.
failed_attempts: V2 parity was near-blind to roughness (dE ~2.82–3.07 across 0.1→0.9); ocular sensitivity lane widens roughness response (authoritative delta_e2000 spans recorded in summary).
limitations: Material labels on remote are pixel hypotheses, not measured BRDFs.
Decomposition is sensitivity-proven more than inverse-render-solved.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed inverse-render or goniometric evidence separating material parameters on real objects, not only synthetic probe sensitivity.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Authoritative sensitivity includes light_direction and exposure parameters; LIGHT_CHANGED event calibration precision=1.0, recall=1.0, fpr=0.0 on sealed fixtures.
limitations: Lighting separation is probe/event level, not full environment map recovery.
No adversarial relighting of a held-out real capture.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Recover lighting that re-renders a held-out view within sealed error under PHYSICAL capture.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Sealed framework includes reflective_transparent target with leakage probes PASS (failures=0, target_count=8). Sensitivity apparatus can stress specular metrics.
limitations: No dedicated ocular scorecard numbers for geometry/material/light separation on reflective/transparent objects (RMSE, confusion rates).
Sealed infrastructure is not the same as passing a quality gate for this facet.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed quality metrics for reflection/transparency separation (not only split isolation) on Benchmark 3.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Data-centre scene has 771 instances / 40 racks; beat 00 passes with non_background_pixel_fraction=0.2357. Portfolio datacenter target executes mesh/procedural.
failed_attempts: Beats 01–08 fail beat_minimums (near-empty renders despite frustum geometry) — 1/9 beats pass.
limitations: Hard-surface procedural world exists; art-direction and camera/lighting for most beats do not.
Critics flag generic composition and procedural sameness.

remaining_blocker.requirement: All nine data-centre beats pass visible-instance and non-background gates under PHYSICAL renders with art-direction review.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Portfolio includes soft_object target; sealed soft_object split isolation PASS. Mesh/point/procedural executed; radiance blocked.
limitations: No fold/leather topology quality metrics beyond portfolio scaffolding.
Soft-object perception is not a measured success — infrastructure only.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Sealed soft-object reconstruction/perception metrics (folds, topology, material) on Benchmark 7.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Portfolio organic_fur target PASS scaffolding; sealed organic_fur isolation PASS. Inherited V2 organic UV packing open failure (~29% vs 35% gate) remains.
failed_attempts: uv-packing-branching-forms carried forward from V2 (~0.29 vs 0.35).
limitations: Organic geometry path is synthetic construction/portfolio, not a wild plant/animal capture.
Ocular loop does not add a new organic quality leaderboard.

remaining_blocker.requirement: UV packing efficiency >= 0.35 on organic_sculpture and plant (currently ~0.29; gate not relaxed).

facets.external_heldout_evidence: organic_fur portfolio and sealed target exist. V2 baseline records synthetic fur lane (guides/guards) — no authorized real-animal capture.
limitations: Fur lane is synthetic only; real-animal capture is an external blocker.
No temporal groom/occlusion quality score for ocular streams.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Rights-cleared multiview stills/video of a real animal with OWNED or LICENSED rights_state and ethical-use attestation.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Repair corpus: 23/23 drills PASS (12 PHYSICAL, 11 DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY), blocked_count=0, including browser-blank-first-frame, browser-dom-pixel-contradiction, browser-focus-trap. Sealed browser_page leakage probes PASS.
failed_attempts: Beat-run browser probe failed: Playwright chromium_headless_shell executable missing at run time.
limitations: Browser eyeball works as a diagnostic/repair runtime more than as a continuous ocular stream source in the beat film run.
Pixel/DOM dual evidence is demonstrated in drills, not a long live session.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Continuous browser/screen stream under PHYSICAL playwright/chrome with sealed page tasks, not only diagnostic drills.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Repair drills cover source_rendered_mismatch and DOM/pixel contradictions; sealed browser_page isolation prevents oracle leakage into builder.
limitations: Source-to-pixel is proven mainly via injected-fault repair drills, not production SPA coverage.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Source-to-pixel chain on a real multi-route SPA with sealed expected render digests.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Beat coverage run-summary passed=true: 9 of 9 beats meet declared minimums with zero failures, execution_class PHYSICAL, sealed per-beat digests. non_background_pixel_fraction 0.611-0.958 against a 0.15-0.20 minimum. Critics still fire generic_composition and procedural_sameness, so composition quality remains unproven even though the density and resolvability gates now pass.
failed_attempts: Originally 8 of 9 beats read empty/near-empty while frustum_instance_count ran into the hundreds. Diagnosed as underexposure rather than black renders: 96-100% of pixels carried signal at means of 24-46. Root cause was two lamps lighting a 19 m aisle, about 14x inverse-square falloff from beat 00 to beat 08. Fixed by lighting the set, not the gate.
limitations: Cinematic path is not art-directed; composition scores remain template-like.
Do not treat instance counts as beat coverage.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Every data-centre beat populated and art-directed; human art-director sign-off still required for 100-class claims.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: critic_calibration.json all_passed=true on positive/near_threshold/negative/confounder/false_positive_check cells; sensitivity.critic_all_passed=true. Critics also fire on beat film.
limitations: Critic calibration is on synthetic matrix cells, not a human taste panel.
Critics correctly flag bad beats; they do not fix composition.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Human art-director adjudication paired with critic scores on flagship film beats.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Stream processes 48 frames incrementally with 0 drops and monotonic timestamps; MCP callthrough duration_s≈1.733 for 19 tools. Incremental=true, loaded_wholesale=false.
limitations: No hard real-time SLA (ms/frame budget, p95 latency) receipt for the full ocular loop.
Latency is only weakly evidenced by successful incremental processing.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Publish per-stage p50/p95 latency on a declared frame rate with drop policy under PHYSICAL load.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Attestation law: webcam BLOCKED without fabricated frames; sealed and repair lanes run under PHYSICAL/DIAGNOSTIC classes without fallback physical PASS. Baseline records fallback audit: physical_pass_reachable_from_fallback=false.
limitations: Authority discipline is strong; many perceptual qualities remain weak.
DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY drills must never be narrated as PHYSICAL product proof.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Sealed receipt status=PASS, failures=0, target_count=8; leakage_matrix probes all blocked as required (builder cannot read oracle/canary; single split authority). Detection and prediction paths refuse GT keys in builder role.
limitations: Leakage resistance is about split isolation, not about high perception scores.
Canary tests pass; quality tests may still fail honestly.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: n_authoritative=41 sensitivity receipts, n_diagnostic=94, n_receipts=135, physical_blocked=[], false_authoritative=false. Gates that always pass are worthless; this lane records spans against thresholds.
failed_attempts: Inherited V2 roughness-blindness in browser parity is a separate known-open; ocular sensitivity probes improve discrimination on Cycles/physical probes.
limitations: Sensitivity is measured on controlled probes, not arbitrary in-the-wild photos.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Browser/WebGL parity path must also discriminate roughness with high dynamic range (V2 dE sweep near 2.82–3.07 remains open where applicable).

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Portfolio purpose_selections choose procedural for editable_geometry/animation and mesh for measurement/web on datacenter; radiance blocked rather than silently substituted.
limitations: Editability is purpose routing among representations, not a DCC round-trip quality suite.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Round-trip edit in Blender/DCC with sealed geometric/material diff gates after export/import.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Beat run budgets.violations=[] against frozen shell/mobile/js budgets; portfolio selects mesh for web purpose. Browser launch for beat film failed (Playwright binary missing).
failed_attempts: Browser gate failure in beat summary (playwright chromium missing).
limitations: Budget compliance is not the same as a beautiful, complete film delivery.
8/9 beats fail visual density — web shell budgets can pass while content fails.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Web delivery of a fully populated, reviewed data-centre film with browser runtime green.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Stream lists per-entity uncertainties; world belief updates=18; vision.list_uncertainties and measure_information_gain execute. Permanence correctly refuses to claim uncertainty behaviour it does not achieve (questions fail).
failed_attempts: uncertainty_grew_while_occluded and uncertainty_fell_after_reid fail sealed checks.
limitations: Uncertainty is reported; its calibration against outcomes is weak (see surprise ECE/noise).

remaining_blocker.requirement: Calibrated uncertainty (ECE/reliability) tying reported sigmas to sealed error rates across conditions.

facets.external_heldout_evidence: Eight sealed synthetic/procedural targets and eleven hard tracking conditions exist. No three unseen real-world authorized targets. No score reaches 100/105/110.
limitations: Generalization is unsupported at 105-class: lacks three unseen real targets.
All strong numbers are on procedural/Blender fixtures or governed self-captured remote.

remaining_blocker.requirement: Three unseen real-world targets with authorized captures, scored under frozen thresholds without manual implementation changes.

known_open_failures.summary: Detection precision 0.196 and recall 0.384 on sealed hard suite (improved from recall 0.011 / large-area blobs 1.00/frame).
Perception-driven tracking suite FAILS: permanence id_switches=22>12, crossing_paths id_switches=14>12, unknown entrant absorbed.
Sealed permanence n_pass=1 of 4 questions; status FAIL.
3551 surprises fired, 28 true positives, overall precision 0.007885 (~0.8%); verdict=noise.

5 of 9 retina event types fire on their confounder fixture (confounder_violation=true); unfit_event_types lists 5 events. Deliberate event tests rose from 3 to 6 failures after confounder fixtures were added — new truth, not a regression to hide.
Data-centre beat coverage: 1/9 beats pass; beats 01–08 fail visible-instance and non-background gates (frustum/render mismatch).

known_open_failures.blocker_requirement: Physical camera present and permitted on the evaluation host.
known_open_failures.summary: Webcam index 0 cannot be opened; execution_class=BLOCKED; fabricated_live_frame=false.
Eight currently-failing tests are deliberate: 2 in test_ocular_beats.py and 6 in test_ocular_events.py. Events count rose from 3 to 6 because new confounder fixtures exposed real defects.

quarantine.reason: Measured evidence shows a continuous perception scaffold with honest attestation and sealed isolation, but core loop qualities are weak: detection precision 0.196, surprise precision 0.0079, permanence 1/4, tracking suite fails 3 gates, 5/9 retina events fire on confounders, 8/9 film beats empty. Not a launch document.

deliberate_failing_tests.note: Events deliberate failures rose from 3 to 6 after confounder fixtures were added this session — new measured truth, not a hidden regression.
